summary: KKR FS Income Trust Select filed an 8-K solely to declare a monthly dividend of $0.175 per share payable on August 27, 2026, to holders of record July 31, 2026; shareholders may elect cash or stock under its distribution reinvestment plan. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, restructuring, or other special situation is disclosed. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special event. No action or regulatory clock applies. No risk-arb angle exists; the filing is operational and not event-driven.
